title: ServisFirst Bank Reaffirms Long-Term Commitment to Tallahassee with New $10 Million Office

## New 10,000-Square-Foot Office Consolidates Bank’s Tallahassee Operations and Demonstrates Its Continued Investment in the Market


Tallahassee, Fl.–[ServisFirst Bank](https://protect.checkpoint.com/v2/___https://servisfirstbank.com/___.YzJ1OnNlcnZpc2ZpcnN0YmFuazE2ODQ4NDI5NDUwNTU6YzpvOjYxOGQ3ZDhmNGEwY2FjZDYxYjg0OTQ2ZGMwNTU3NDNiOjY6MTJhNjplMzcyZjUyZDgzNjcyZTU4OWUxZGFhMjU5NjkxNGExZDdhOTZjY2RjZWNiYzIxNzkxNzVjNjQ0NjhlNjYzMGVkOnA6VDpO) , a subsidiary of ServisFirst Bancshares (NYSE:SFBS), is pleased to announce the groundbreaking of its new **$10 million** **office** at 1510 Delaney Drive in Tallahassee, Florida. The groundbreaking ceremony was attended by the Mayor of Tallahassee, members of the local ServisFirst Bank team, Rex McKinney and members of the bank’s Board of Directors, **marking an important milestone in the Bank’s continued investment in the Tallahassee market.**


The $10 million investment in the new location represents ServisFirst Bank’s continued commitment to serving Tallahassee and the surrounding communities. The approximately **10,000-square-foot, two-story facility** will bring the Bank’s existing commercial banking and mortgage teams together in one centralized location, creating a dedicated home for its Tallahassee operations. The office is expected to accommodate 20 to 25 employees and will include an ATM and two drive-through lanes to provide convenient banking services for customers.


> “Breaking ground on the Bank’s new Tallahassee office sends an important message about our commitment to this market and the future we see here,” states Rex McKinney, ServisFirst Bank, Northwest Florida Regional CEO. “We are invested in Tallahassee and plan to continue serving this community for years to come. Bringing our local teams together under one roof will allow us to better serve our customers, support our employees and continue building on the relationships we have established.”


Once complete, the new office will consolidate ServisFirst Bank’s existing Tallahassee offices, currently located at 1701 Hermitage Boulevard, Suite 104, Tallahassee, Florida 32308, and its Tallahassee Mortgage Office at 3375 Capital Circle NE, Building B1, Tallahassee, Florida 32308.[Southland Contracting, Inc.](https://protect.checkpoint.com/v2/r01/___https://southlandcontracting.com/___.YzJ1OnNlcnZpc2ZpcnN0YmFuazE2ODQ4NDI5NDUwNTU6YzpvZmZpY2UzNjVfZW1haWxzX2F0dGFjaG1lbnQ6YTBjNjFkOTQ0NmY1OTNjMjRhODM3ZGM3ZjU0NThmMzY6Nzo2Yjg4OjAyZGQxNWE0YzQxNGE4NzhiZTJjNjU3ZGFlMjljODFkMWQ5ODM3NmE0Zjk3M2ZjZWE2YjIwZGQ2MDg5ZWRkODQ6cDpUOkY) is serving as the general contractor for the project, with[Quina Grundhoefer Architects, P.A.](https://protect.checkpoint.com/v2/r01/___https://www.qgarchitects.com/___.YzJ1OnNlcnZpc2ZpcnN0YmFuazE2ODQ4NDI5NDUwNTU6YzpvZmZpY2UzNjVfZW1haWxzX2F0dGFjaG1lbnQ6YTBjNjFkOTQ0NmY1OTNjMjRhODM3ZGM3ZjU0NThmMzY6NzpmNzY1OmVhMjNmOWZkNTA1MWVlNDgwMDBiNzMzZTNhMjE1NTdhZWZhYTM4MTViMmNmZmY2NGE3YzRmYjk5Y2RmNDI0NzQ6cDpUOkY) serving as the architect. Construction is underway, with completion anticipated in summer 2027.

### ABOUT SERVISFIRST BANK


ServisFirst Bank is a full-service commercial bank focused on commercial banking, correspondent banking, treasury management, private banking and the professional consumer market, emphasizing competitive products, state-of-the-art technology and a focus on quality service. Recently, the Bank announced that its assets exceed $18 billion. The Bank offers sophisticated treasury management products, Internet banking, home mortgage lending, remote deposit express banking, and highly competitive rates.


ServisFirst Bank was formed in May 2005, and has offices in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia. In April 2015, and annually thereafter, ServisFirst Bank has earned investment- grade ratings and a stable outlook from Kroll BondRating Agency (KBRA), which measures companies’ financial fundamentals. ServisFirst Bancshares, Inc. files periodic reports with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
